graphEvents.label: What can the Figma MCP build and refuse in FigJam
FigJam writes live in the CLI fj group

label: FigJam authoring exists only as the CLI fj group: fj list|info|nodes read-only, fj sticky|shape|text|connect|move|update mutating, fj delete destructive, fj eval arbitrary.
The registered Figma MCP is the third-party Framelink server over the Figma REST API; it does not drive Figma Desktop and cannot create or edit FigJam nodes.
figma-ds-cli ships no MCP server; an MCP for Figma is always a separate external server, so the skill is CLI-primary with an opt-in read MCP.
Every FigJam write is MUTATING and needs confirmation, an explicit target and a one-line rollback; destructive and arbitrary verbs are omitted from the default path.
FigJam writes cannot run headless: Figma Desktop must be open with a file, a local daemon on 127.0.0.1:3456 must be healthy, Node 18+ is required, and macOS is the supported baseline.
The documented command surface drifts from source, so FigJam verbs and flags must be verified with --help before a Product Owner procedure relies on them.
